provider: China Mobile Cloud (中国移动云盘, 139 / 和彩云)

free_tier.stated: 1,000 GB (1 TB) free per the Wikipedia table, with 20 GB the base grant and 1 TB or 2 TB obtained through carrier promotions. Membership promos are cited at 8 TB

per_object_cap.stated: Varies by tier; single-file and upload caps are not published as one number

retention.stated: Promotional capacity expires. No retention clock on stored files is published

egress.terms: Free and unthrottled by design: '不限速：上传下载不限速', and members get carrier zero-rating on China Mobile. Forum consensus agrees China Mobile does not shape, unlike Baidu at 0.1 MB/s and Quark at 1.7 MB/s

tooling: an official open platform at open.yun.139.com, application and approval based; the OpenList 139Yun driver works off a browser-captured Authorization header and needs v3.41.0 or later; netdisk-fast-download's p139 parser is in the paid tier
chaining: 1 TB free with no shaping is genuinely attractive for serving, and multiplying by accounts is the only path. The gate is a China Mobile number, and the large grants ride the carrier plan and evaporate when it lapses

limits.value: parameters must be scraped from the browser network tab, so an interactive login is mandatory for the driver

identity_cost.detail: +86 only, and the login is tied to a China Mobile subscriber identity in practice. Promotions are redeemed inside the carrier app's 权益超市, not on the web

reliability_note: The driver is reverse-engineered and the share endpoints change shape: getOutLinkInfoV5 and V6 both exist and both answer resultCode 01000101 to an unauthenticated caller.
